description: This file is a CMake script used for detecting the presence and configuration of the gstreamer-video-1.0 library within a build system. It defines variables, performs checks for package availability, and sets up import targets to link against the library if found.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Searches for and loads a CMake package configuration.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a package using pkg-config.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes and executes another CMake script.

methods.name: FIND_PACKAGE_HANDLE_STANDARD_ARGS
methods.description: Standard CMake macro for handling package result variables.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced so they are hidden from normal CMake GUIs.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds a library and sets a variable to its location.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates a new library target, here used as an imported target.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties on a target, such as location and interface options.
